com_ui_memory_page_subtitle: What the assistant remembers about you: your profile, and the memories of each agent.
com_ext_memory_reference_saved_help: Your consent to be remembered. While this is on, the assistant and any agent with memory enabled by its author (including agents others share with you) can recall and save memories about you. Turn it off to stop all of them; agent memory settings then have no effect. To pause memory for a single conversation, use the Memory button in the composer instead.
com_ext_memory_paused_settings: Memory is paused for your account, so these settings take effect once it is on.
com_ext_memory_paused_builder: Memory is paused for your account, so this agent will not recall or save memories for you until you turn it back on.
com_nav_info_memory_tool_delete: Allows the agent to delete stored memories when you ask it to forget something.
com_nav_info_memory_tool_recall: Allows the agent to read from memory — both automatically at the start of a turn and on demand. Disable for an agent that should save but never read memories.
com_nav_info_memory_tool_store: Allows the agent to save new memories from the conversation.
com_nav_info_memory_tool_update: Allows the agent to edit an existing memory in place when you correct or refine a fact, instead of storing a duplicate.
com_ui_memory_delete_all_confirm: This permanently deletes every memory in this scope, including its knowledge graph. This cannot be undone.
com_ui_memory_export_empty: There are no memories in this scope to export.

com_nav_info_reply_notification_sound: Play a short chime when a reply arrives while you are away from the app. Browsers block audio until you have interacted with the page, so the first chime after opening a tab may not play.
com_nav_info_reply_notifications: Show a desktop notification when a reply arrives while you are away from the app. Your browser will ask for permission the first time you enable this. Notifications are not shown while you are looking at the app, since the conversation list already marks the reply.
com_ui_api_keys_description: API keys let external apps and tools run your agents through this app's OpenAI-compatible API. Treat each one like a password: anyone who has it can act as you, so revoke any keys you no longer use.
com_ui_code_environment_unavailable: Self-service code workers are not enabled here.
com_ui_code_environment_remove_descripti: This revokes the worker before removing it. Its sandbox files remain on your VM.
com_ext_memory_use_profile_help: Read the profile of the person using this agent (about them and their preferences) and save lasting facts about them to it. Turn off for agents that run on their own, such as scheduled or channel agents: they then use and save only this agent's own memories.
com_ui_mcp_app_tool_denied: This tool is blocked by the administrator approval policy.
